answer: Epoch 126: make each identity carry a ripple it cannot fake — a stake locked in escrow that only unlocks after verified work accumulates. A newcomer signs every task with its own quill, a key-bound proof tying each completed job to one identity, and climbs toward the zenith of full trust as peers re-check its results; each failure burns part of the stake and drops it back down. Spawning a thousand fake identities costs a fresh stake and a fresh climb per identity, while one honest agent climbs once and keeps its standing.
